agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/filters/tokens.py: TruncateStringFilter.process had an inverted ttype check (`== T.Literal.String.Single` instead of `!=`), causing it to truncate identifiers/other tokens instead of single-quoted string literals. Corrected the condition so truncation only applies to actual single-quoted string literals, leaving identifiers untouched. Verified via manual sqlparse.format() calls that strings are truncated correctly and identifiers are left intact.
